assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: a single English vocabulary learning illustration.
Exact target meaning: nineteen (num.) — 十九. Do not print this target wording.
Primary request: Exactly nineteen separate small round red apples, each with one short brown stem, arranged neatly in four horizontal rows: five apples in the first row, five in the second, five in the third, and four in the fourth. Make all nineteen individually countable and fully separated by clear gaps, no overlaps, no extra apples, no leaves shaped like apples. This is one simple educational still-life arrangement showing the exact quantity nineteen, without printed numerals or any text.
Style/medium: hand-painted gouache with subtle colored-pencil texture on warm off-white paper. Square composition, subject or tightly related scene centered within the middle 70 percent, generous empty paper margins, fully visible and legible on a small vocabulary card. Soft daylight, natural muted colors and gentle shadows. Constraints: no letters, printed numerals, words, written labels, logos, watermarks, borders or card UI; no unrelated decorative objects.
